title: Prove explicit production precision for the direct circulant word, including partial-gate and cache bounds
body:
## A local numerical theorem for the actual #7849 word

This package proves a smaller sufficient fractional precision for the original direct-circulant Fourier computation at #7849, including coefficient synthesis, partial routed gates, cached tensor coefficients and state-relative data rounding. It is a **local analytic interface theorem under named source contracts**, with a separate accepting review. No complete canonical assumption is removed and **no new κ** is claimed.

[Proof](https://github.com/CubeJerry/integer-mult-bounds/blob/13561dbdf4971a7ae0901d2f43df8de3981e94a5/research/direct-circulant-production-precision/PROOF.md) · [Independent cross-review](https://github.com/CubeJerry/integer-mult-bounds/blob/13561dbdf4971a7ae0901d2f43df8de3981e94a5/research/direct-circulant-production-precision/review/CROSS-REVIEW.md) · [Executed registered replay](https://github.com/CubeJerry/integer-mult-bounds/blob/13561dbdf4971a7ae0901d2f43df8de3981e94a5/research/direct-circulant-production-precision/evidence/registered-replay.txt)

### Exact result

For d≥1 axes with true orders 2≤r_i≤2^ell_i, ell_i≥1, public p≥1 and L=sum ell_i, set:

```text
E = ceil(1257 L / 2) + 2154 d
A = 104 L + 438 d
J = 20000 (d+1) (max ell_i+2)^6
C = 4 J (d+1)^2 + d+1
P = 4p + A + 2E + bit_length(C).
```

Use P in the external Grid and the unchanged P+8 coefficient-construction call. On every represented complete padded input of maximum modulus at most one half, raw coordinate error is strictly below 2^(-4p), for both signs. The ideal transform is the true Fourier mean with identity on local holes. The inherited public-grid recovery theorem still gives integer error at most 144/B^2<1/2 for B≥32, under its CRT character, true-volume, scaling and no-wrap hypotheses.

The new linear term is 4p+1361L+4746d+(L mod 2), compared with the source's 4p+32768(L+6d). At p=72 and axis widths (4,5), the sufficient fractional precision falls from 688,620 to 22,068 bits. This is a selector comparison, not a measured transform speedup, minimum-precision result or memory theorem. The proof also shows the original selector is larger on every supported input, validating its numerical budget under the same contracts.

### What closes the source-specific gap

The rounded circulant root remains strictly accretive on every leading section, giving the actual inverse allowance. Substitution into the retained full compiler estimates yields physical prefix and inverse bounds 2^98 t^52. The literal sixteen-H lowering and routing give 2^537 t^156 per root and 2^1076 t^314 per axis. Prefix and inverse-prefix bounds control arbitrary external intervals; endpoint conditioning alone is insufficient.

A coefficient-cache invariant states that each stored suffix is the rounded expression in the current coordinate factors. Carrying rebuilds exactly the affected suffix. Its error therefore depends on the number of axes, not the number of earlier tensor records. The resulting local defect is at most (d+1)^2 2^(-P+A)(1+norm(z)). Diagonal and H actions are separate mathematical steps, so a pre-H rounding error is propagated. The final selector makes both the bootstrap spend and raw-error bound strict.

The separate reviewer found a harmless prose census ambiguity: fully expanded lowering has 23 diagonals and 16 H factors, hence 38 non-pivot factors. Those two sentences were corrected; 64^40 and every selector constant remain unchanged. The accepted proof hash is 26e4e214f0a5785c1d1414561465bb49a3248f9e6f59f6b514eb95a887bdfe2f. Its original pre-review status line is preserved for hash identity; the later review records acceptance.

### Reproduction and independent evidence

With standard-library CPython 3.12, from the repository root:

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/direct-circulant-production-precision
python3 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/direct-circulant-production-precision --check-modes
```

All three registered commands passed in orchestrator execution. Normal and optimized author checks cover 203 exact two-wire words, 2,448 odometer records, 60 allocator bindings and 53 selector inputs. Controls reject source corruption, wrong phases, omitted inverse-prefix reasoning, stale suffixes, missing column guards and undercharged precision.

The separate reviewer did not use the author's checker as independent evidence. A new Gaussian-rational interpreter checks 600 literal words across all four pivots; noncommutative expression trees check 1,214 cache-lineage records. Wrong-sign and stale-cache mutations fail. A positive-coefficient polynomial certificate bounds the unbounded schedule count. Universal conclusions rest on the written inequalities, not extrapolation from these finite cases.

Six frozen executable fixtures are authenticated by Git blob and SHA256 pins. Source proofs, read hashes, reviews and receipts are retained. Remote head 13561dbdf4971a7ae0901d2f43df8de3981e94a5 has exactly the tested local tree: 30 added files, zero deletions. Committed bytes and modes passed at that head. Strict source-history preflight was not claimed from the shallow checkout. Hosted CI success is not claimed; the unchanged base's #6030/#7000 documentation mismatch stopped #8091 before package selection.

### Scope, overlap and credit

Canonical base: e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57. Principal source: Ali Romman's #7849 at 3615fd982f2f4dc7172bef6f0dc9a4f77d5ab6dd. Task uniform-transfer-audit is refined to this production numerical implication. The complete rational compiler estimates, certified unit-phase service, exact native H on sufficiently widened private grids, and outer CRT/recovery contracts remain explicit premises.

#7981 changes chronology and the intermediate target, and has an asymptotically smaller selector. **This package is not an improvement over that successor.** It sharpens the original same-chronology contract and reusable local root/interval estimates, subject to a new applicability check for any changed caller. It does not relabel a known low diagnostic-precision failure as a production failure.

Open next steps are the all-size private-grid and owned-arena interface, and independent certification of the inherited full compiler estimates. No production-sized transform, full rounded multiplier, complete tape tariff, selected-certificate change or kernel proof is claimed.

Prepared for Jerry Chen / @CubeJerry with substantial OpenAI assistance and separate task-agent author/reviewer roles. Credit Ali Romman for #7849 and its integration, Jose Manuel (jmbarrancoml) for the retained full rational compiler, Vlado Vojdanovski for displacement/tensor compilation, Chafik Boukhalfa for certified phases, Cinna Davis and the retained native/recovery contributors. Source notices and Apache-2.0 attribution are preserved. This is model-assisted review, not independent human peer review.
